history.reason: critic: Belief overstates uncertainty. More importantly, the core evidence for capacity strain — 119 high-confidence speed tests showing 35% multi-quarter decline and a busy-cell capacity signal — is direct measurement independent of site locations. The caveat is valid but does not materially undermine the capacity conclusion.

Measured cells are on average 26% below their reference median. 119 Ookla tests in the latest quarter averaging 28.5 Mbps (data confidence: high). Speed fell 35% from the oldest to the latest quarter. On average 4.0 operators have approximate sites within 5 km of its cells (EE, O2, Three, Vodafone somewhere nearby).
